@Dbr, glad to help.  Usually we think of the response variable as being on the vertical axis and the predictor variable on the horizontal axis.  With this setup, everything is vertical--regression is minimizing the vertical distances between the predictions and the response variable (SSE).  Likewise, the residual SD is a measure of vertical dispersion after having accounted for the predicted values.  Finally, R^2 is the ratio of the vertical dispersion of your predictions to the total vertical dispersion of your raw data.
